source: Generated by running Ims.Domain.Common.EmailAddress.Normalize (System.Net.Mail.MailAddress, .NET 10.0.5) over edge cases and random strings (all edge cases plus a fixed random sample of 2500 valid and 2500 invalid results). Each case is [input, normalized address] or [input, "!<error code>"]. Inputs with unpaired UTF-16 surrogates are excluded (JSON cannot carry them).
